notes.note: Scoped final evidence-reader review: duplicate gate references are now coalesced by the full run/gate/evaluation tuple within verifyTaskReviewEvidence for one request. The original evidence claims and gate verdict rules are unchanged. The real Codex-token MCP test invokes FlowRunService.readGateEvaluation without replacing its implementation: three refs with one duplicate previously caused three owner reads (red assertion expected two); the fix permits two distinct reads and a retry reads both again, preserving freshness between requests. No persistent cache, cross-Task authority, status, endpoint or public DTO change is introduced. Existing prose remains accurate; this does not qualify a live Flow/provider journey. The final 6-case MCP suite also proves that a present Git blob stays claimed (commitVerified false), while a real commit verifies and an absent commit stays claimed. The authority route bytes still equal the byte-exact final fault receipt at 79ab3ff5742; no authority behavior was changed by batching.
